chapter.verse: Biakinnpi nusia-in Jesu a paikhiat laitak, biakinnpi innmengte a lak dingin Jesu' kiangah nungzuite hong pai hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Hihte a vekin na mu khinta uh hi. Maantak kong cihin ah hih suangtumte a kicimlo, khat tungah khat a kithuap lai, cih bang om lo ding hi,” ci-in dawng hi.

Olive Mual tungah Jesu a tut laitak nungzuite amau teng guak hong pai uh a, “Hong gen dih in. Hih thute cik ciang hong piang ding hiam? Nong pai ding vai leh hih khanghun a bei ding vai kihilna lim bang hiding hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin dawng hi: “Kuamah in note lam hong pialsak loh nading kidawm un.
A hang pen keima' min tawh mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, ‘Kei Khris ka hi,’ ci-in mi tampi lampialsak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin galkidona thute leh gal vai thulengsawnte na za ding uh hi. Na patauh loh nadingun kidawm un. A hang pen hih thu a piang hamtang ding hi a, ahi zongin a beina hi nailo hi.
A hang pen minam khatlekhat, kumpigam khatlekhat kigalbawl ding uh a, mun tuamtuam ah kialpi tungin zinling ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh nausuah natna a kipat nading hi pan hi.
“Tua ciangin mite in gimna thuak dingin hong lehhek uh banah hong that ding uh a, keima' min hangin Gentile mi khempeuh in hong mudah ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin mi tampi lalthang ding uh a, khatlekhat kilehhekin khatlekhat kimudah ding uh hi.
Kamsang zuau tampi hong laang ding a, mi tampi lampialsak ding uh hi.
Thukhun pampaihna khang ding a, mi tampite' sungah itna kiam ding hi.
Ahi zongin a tawp dong a thuakzote in hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin minam khempeuh' tungah teci ahi dingin leitung bup ah kumpigam Lungdamna Thu kitangko ding a, tua ciangin beina hun hong tung ding hi.
“Tua hi a, a lipkhap-huai guaksuakna ci-in kamsang Daniel' gen ngei pen siangtho mun ah hong ding na muh uh ciangin (laisimte in tel pah unla)
Judea gam sunga om mite mualtungte ah taimang uh hen.
Innkhum tunga omte zong inn sunga van a la dingin kumsuk kei ta hen.
Lo sunga omte zong puansilh a la dingin ciah nawn kei ta uh hen.
Tua hun sungin numei naupaaite leh naungek neite a dahhuaizia!
Tua na galtai hun uh phalbi sung ahihkeileh Sabbath ni ahihloh nading thungen un.
A hang pen leitung piancil-a kipan tu ciangdong a piang ngei nailo, cikmah ciangin zong a piang ngei nawnlo ding gimna lianpi hong tung ding hi.
Gimna nite kitomsak lo hileh mihing a suakta kuamah om lo ding a, ahi zongin teeltuam mite khualna-in tua nite kitomsak ding hi.
Tua hun ciangin mi khatpeuh in note' kiangah, ‘En un, hih lai-ah Khris om!’ ahihkeileh, ‘Hua lai-ah om!’ hong cih leh um kei un.
A hang pen khris kineihkhemte leh kamsang zuaute hong piang ding a, ahih zawhleh teeltuam mite nangawn lampialsak nadingin kihilna lim lamdang a lianpipite bawl ding uh hi.
Ngai un, a hun tun ma-in thu kong genkhol khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin tua mite in, ‘En un, amah gamlak ah om hi,’ hong cih uhleh va pusuak kei un. Tua mite in, ‘En un, amah inndei sungtawng ah om hi,’ hong cih uhleh umkha kei un.
A hang pen nisuahlam pana khuaphialep in nitumlam pek dong a taan mah bangin Mihing' Tapa hong pai ciangin zong tua bang hiding hi.
Misiluang omna peuh ah musanete kikaikhawm ding uh hi.
“Gimna a tun khit phetin ni mialin kha zong taang lo ding hi. Vantung pan aksite kiasuk ding uh a, vantunga om vangliante kilok kiling ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin vantung ah Mihing' Tapa a kihilna lim hong kilang ding hi. Leitung minam khempeuh dahin kap ding uh a, vangliatna leh minpha vangtaang a lianpi tawh vantung meiilom tung tuanga hong pai Mihing' Tapa mu ding uh hi.
Amah in a vanmite pengkul nakpi tumsakin sawlkhia ding a, vanmite in vantung mong khat pan mong khat dong, kimkot mun li panin ama' teeltuam mite kaikhawm ding uh hi.
“Theikung tungtawnin hih thugenteh sinin thei un: a hiang meengkhia-in a teh a sel ciangin khuakhal hun nai ta cih na thei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin hih thute na muh uh ciangin amah kongbiang dong hong nai ta cih thei ta un.
Maantak kong cihin ah tu-a khangmite a bei ma-in hih thute khempeuh hong piang ding hi.
Vantung leh leitung maimang ding a, ka thugente maimang lo ding hi.
“Ahi zongin tua hunleni leh tua hunlenai vai a thei kuamah om lo hi. Vantunga vanmite (leh Tapa nangawn) in zong thei lo uh a, Pa bek in thei hi.
A hang pen Mihing' Tapa hong pai ding vai zong Noah' hun lai dan mah hiding hi.
Tuicin tun ma, tua sawng tengin tembaw sungah Noah a lut ni dongin mite anne tuidawnin mo kipi kikha uh hi.
Tuicin tungin mi khempeuh tui in a taih tanghial ciangdong tua mite khuaphawk lo-in a om dan bangun Mihing' Tapa hong pai ciangin zong tua dan mah hiding hi.
Tua hun ciangin lokuan mi nih lakah khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi.
An-gawina ah an-gawi numei nih om ding a, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi.
“Tua ahih manin pilvang navak un. A hang pen na Topa uh bang ni-in hong pai ding cih na thei kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu theitel un: Inntekpa in gutapa zan hun nai bangzahin hong pai ding cih theician hileh amah navak takin na om ding a, a inn kiluhsak lo ding hi.
Tua hi a, note zong na kiginkholh uh kul ding hi. A hang pen na upmawh loh uh hunlenai khat ah Mihing' Tapa hong pai ding hi.
“Tua ahihleh a kiseh hunin innsung silate an a pia dingin a topa in tuate' tungah panmun a guat, a citak leh a lungpil sila i cih kua ahi hiam?
A topa' hong pai ciangin tua bangin nasemin om a muh tua silapa thuphangah ahi hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah a topa in a neihsa khempeuh a kem dingin tua silapa vaipuak ap ding hi.
Ahih hangin mihoihlo silapa in a lungsim sungah, ‘Ka topa hong ciah hak ding hi,’ ci-in
a lawm sila dangte sat henla zunete tawh kithuahin zune sane-in na om hileh,
silapa' upmawh loh hunleni khat leh a theihkholh loh hunlenai khat ah a topa tung ding a,
silapa' tungah a suksiabel gawtna nam pia-in a puatham kineihte tawh koihkhawm ding hi. Tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.
